posts.title: The Rise of Autonomous Agents: A 2026 Perspective
posts.subtitle: We are moving from 'Chatbots' that talk, to 'Agents' that do.
posts.excerpt: Software is no longer a tool; it's a teammate. Discover how AI Agents are rewriting the rules of automation and what it means for developers.
posts.author: Dr. Amit Patil
posts.content:
The Paradigm Shift

For the last decade, we interacted with software by clicking buttons. In the era of LLMs, we started typing prompts. In 2026, we are entering the era of Delegation.

You won't tell software how to do something; you will tell it what outcome you want. The Agent figures out the rest.

Implementation

async function agentLoop(goal) {
  let memory = [];
  while (!achieved) {
    let action = await planner.decide(goal, memory);
    await execute(action);
  }
}

posts.title: Angular 19: The Zoneless Future
posts.subtitle: Why Zone.js is finally retiring.
posts.excerpt: Angular 19 brings the biggest change in a decade: Zoneless applications. Learn how to migrate your enterprise apps to the new reactivity model.
posts.author: Rahul Deshmukh
posts.content:
Why Zoneless?

Zone.js has served us well, but it monkey-patches browser APIs. This overhead accumulates in large applications. Angular 19 allows us to drop it entirely.

Migration Strategy

Start by converting leaf components.

count = signal(0);
increment() {
  this.count.update(c => c + 1);
}

This simple change removes the need for Zone.js to track button clicks.
